notes: Adds a Stunt coins section to the Tesla page. The coin counter is found the same way the car attributes are - it scans the player's leaderstats, any one-level folder on the player, and the player's attributes - and prefers a name that says stunt or coin over a generic money/cash one. The section names where the value came from, puts the current value in an editable box (Text, not placeholder, with a Set button and Enter), and reports honestly that it is a client-side write which the server may revert. A SCAN button re-finds the value if the HUD is created later.
